tasks.text: On the 조직 구성 slide, what is the outline (width, line style and colour) of the connectors? Answer `ANSWER: border="<width> <style> <colour>"`.
On the 추진 절차 slide, which shapes are filled accent2? Answer `ANSWER: <name>; <name>`.
Change the fill of the card "Rounded Rectangle 3" (+12%) to accent2.
Give the shape "Oval 4" (VS) a 2pt navy outline.
In "10월 착수 예정", make "10월" 24pt and coral.
Make the three connectors on the 조직 구성 slide 3pt wide, keeping their colour and line style.
Change "신규 4곳" to "신규 5곳", keeping its formatting exactly as it is.
Make the gradient of the left panel on the first slide run from navy to teal.
